title: Prompt-Pay Discount Policy for the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing)
content:
A patient who pays the entire remaining balance of one Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account in a single payment earns the prompt-pay discount on that account.

## 1. The prompt-pay window

The full payment must post no later than the prompt-pay window counted from the first post-discharge statement date. Count calendar days starting the day after the first statement date; a payment whose posting date is the last day of the window still qualifies. Both dates are read from the account's records: the first statement date of the account and the posting date of the payment.

*Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, a window of 30 calendar days).* With a first statement date of 1 June, day 1 of the window is 2 June and day 30 is 1 July. A full payment posting on 1 July qualifies; one posting on 2 July does not.

## 2. Sentence no longer in force

The sentence that the discount is the prompt-pay discount percent of the patient balance standing immediately before the payment (after the uninsured discount where the terms stack the two), rounded half-up to the cent, that the payment amount due is that balance less the discount, and that the discount posts as a prompt-pay discount adjustment whose source is the qualifying payment, is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis. The prompt-pay figures of each patient class remain valid.

## 3. When the discount is not available

The discount is not available when:

- the balance before payment is below the class's prompt-pay minimum balance;
- the payment channel is not one of the eligible channels;
- the account has received a financial-assistance charity adjustment (the exclusion after a charity adjustment); or
- the account is enrolled in an active or past-due Riverbend payment plan (the exclusion under a payment plan).

## 4. One full payment, one discount

A partial payment never earns a partial discount, and the discount is posted at most once per account; an account that already carries a prompt-pay discount adjustment receives no second one.

## Points of reading

| Situation (hypothetical) | Discount |
|---|---|
| Full balance paid by mailed check on the last day of the window | available, other conditions met |
| Full balance paid by a payment plan installment | not available |
| Half the balance paid inside the window | not available |

superseded_clauses: The discount is prompt_pay_discount_pct of the patient balance standing immediately before the payment (after the uninsured discount when prompt_pay_stacks_with_uninsured is true), rounded half-up to the cent, and the payment amount due is that balance less the discount; the discount posts as a PROMPT_PAY_DISCOUNT adjustment whose source is the qualifying payment.
